items.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, a faster frontier model for engineering, knowledge work and science
items.summary: Google DeepMind推出Gemini 4 Neon，定位以較快速度完成複雜軟件工程、知識工作同科學流程，官方標價為每百萬代幣輸入3美元、緩存輸入0.15美元（九五折）、輸出15美元，並提供100萬代幣上下文。模型即日起向Gemini API（Google AI Studio）、Gemini for business，以及付費Google AI Pro同Ultra用戶（Google Antigravity同Gemini app）推出。

items.title: OpenAI says coding agents now complete nearly half of two-to-four-hour research tasks
items.summary: OpenAI發表研究加速進度報告，指以內部測量計，估計需時兩至四小時嘅研究任務，代理自主完成率由3月嘅23%升至10月嘅46%；四至八小時任務則由13%升至35%。報告亦稱，以API標價計算，10月研究員每日用量中位數達2,400美元，第90百分位達23,000美元，並強調人類仍然係研究循環嘅核心。

items.title: OpenAI details new frontier-risk controls, including holding back models such as GPT-6.1 Astra
items.summary: OpenAI發表由訓練到部署嘅前沿風險管理說明，指會按安全標準調整發布節奏，包括暫停內部訓練，或暫時扣起GPT-6.1 Astra等未達安全門檻嘅模型。公司稱自7月Hugging Face事件後加強對齊同監察，並引入safety cases等流程，要求模型喺每個階段通過安全審查先進入下一階段。

items.title: CNBC: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, raising $81.3 billion ahead of Thursday's ANT debut
items.summary: CNBC報道，Anthropic週三將IPO定價為每股83美元，高於原先70至78美元區間，並上調發行規模至約9.80億股，籌資813億美元，料為有紀錄以來最大規模上市。公司計劃11月19日以代號ANT喺納斯達克掛牌；截至本批新聞截稿時，公開交易尚未開始，Anthropic官方亦尚未見到載有最終發行價嘅定價新聞稿。
items.note: This updates yesterday's item that Anthropic was likely to price above the $70–$78 range. CNBC reports the $83 price, an upsized sale of about 980 million shares and $81.3 billion raised. Some coverage, including AP, attributes the figures to multiple reports and cites a $1.5 trillion valuation; that valuation is not used here because sources differ on the implied market cap. Anthropic's Canadian Nov 18 release confirms a base PREP prospectus filing but says a supplemented prospectus with pricing information would follow within two business days. Trading had not yet opened in New York at the time of this batch (morning of Nov 19 HKT). publishedAt uses the US cash-market close on Nov 18 (05:00 HKT on Nov 19), when IPO pricing is typically released; CNBC's page also showed an earlier 10:15 a.m. EST byline and was later updated. imageUrl is null because a reliable non-Getty source thumbnail was not confirmed.

Launch independently verified via Steam appdetails for DLC app 5090170 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 18, 2026, US $29.99). Platform list follows yesterday’s official help-center set; this post also says Arcade Edition owners get the expansion on day one at no extra cost. Official spelling in the post is “Villanous Fin.”
items.imageAlt: Official key art for Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea

items.title: Space Station Designer is out now on Steam
items.summary: Slitherine 同 Polar Motion 嘅太空站建造管理遊戲《Space Station Designer》已於 11 月 18 日登陸 Steam，平台為 PC，美國區售價 19.99 美元。玩家經營私營航空公司，喺地球同月球軌道擴建超過 150 個模組，並有 Campaign、Sandbox 同 Free Builder 模式。
items.note: Games Press date is calendar-only (18/11/2026), so publishedAt is date-only. Launch and US $19.99 price verified via Steam API app 1447650 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 18, 2026).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Space Station Designer

items.title: Tiny Dwellings, from the studio behind Moonfrost, is out now on Steam
items.summary: Oxalis Games（Moonfrost 開發室）嘅像素風建造遊戲《Tiny Dwellings》已於 11 月 18 日登陸 Steam，平台為 PC。Steam 美國區原價 7.99 美元，現有 9 折至 7.19 美元。
items.note: Steam API gives a calendar release date only, so publishedAt is date-only. coming_soon=false, date Nov 18, 2026, US $7.99 discounted 10% to $7.19. “Creators of Moonfrost” is from https://www.oxalis.games/ .
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Tiny Dwellings

items.title: Forsaken Lands is out now on Steam, with a two-week 35% launch discount
items.summary: Spaghetti Cat 同 Lunisky Studio 嘅合作 roguelite 卡牌《Forsaken Lands》已於 11 月 18 日登陸 Steam，平台為 PC。遊戲有六位英雄，Story Mode 為單人、Dreams Mode 支援合作。發行商指推出頭兩星期有 35% 折扣，Steam 美國區現為 7.14 美元（原價 10.99 美元）。
items.note: Games Press date is calendar-only, so publishedAt is date-only. Launch and 35% US price verified via Steam API app 2464640 (coming_soon=false, date Nov 18, 2026, $10.99 to $7.14).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Forsaken Lands

items.title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed is dated November 19 for PC, with a shot-for-shot GTA 6 launch-trailer parody
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道，Devolver Digital 將於 11 月 19 日（同《GTA VI》主機版同日）喺 Steam 推出 Doinksoft 嘅橫向動作《Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed》。預告片被形容為幾乎逐鏡重拍《GTA 6》上市預告。今早 Steam API 仍顯示即將推出，美國區原價 4.99 美元、有 25% 折扣至 3.74 美元。
items.note: Do not describe as out now: Steam app 4523120 still returned coming_soon=true with date Nov 19, 2026, when checked on the morning of Nov 19 HKT. PC Gamer page is dated 18 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt is date-only. US price $4.99 / $3.74 (25% off) is from the Steam API; PC Gamer’s “$5” is a rounded figure.
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed

items.title: Homura Hime is coming to PS5 in 2027, and the Switch 2 version slips from 2026 to 2027
items.summary: PLAYISM 同 Crimson Dusk 宣布，3D 彈幕動作《Homura Hime》將於 2027 年登陸 PS5，並同已宣布但由 2026 年延期至 2027 年嘅 Switch 2 版一齊推出。遊戲已先喺 Steam（PC）推出；暫未公布 2027 年具體日期。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 18, 2026, 3:05 PM EST = Nov 19, 04:05 HKT. releaseDate is TBA because only “2027” is given for PS5/Switch 2. The article recaps a prior Steam launch but does not restate the year in this piece, so the summary does not invent that date. Gematsu hero 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: 8BitDo announces a $49.99 GameCube-style Bluetooth pad for Switch, Switch 2 and Windows, shipping December 10
items.summary: 8BitDo 宣布推出 GameCube 風格嘅 GC Bluetooth Gamepad，兼容 Switch、Switch 2 同 Windows，售價 49.99 美元，將於 2026 年 12 月 10 日出貨，有紫色同橙色。規格包括 TMR 搖桿、霍爾線性扳機，並支援 Bluetooth、2.4 GHz 接收器同 USB-C 有線。The Verge 指呢個價錢低於 Nintendo 官方無線 GameCube 控制器嘅 69.99 美元。
items.note: publishedAt uses The Verge’s timestamp Nov 18, 2026, 4:00 PM UTC = Nov 19, 00:00 HKT, which matches the announcement window. Official pages: https://www.8bitdo.com/gc-bluetooth-gamepad/ and https://shop.8bitdo.com/products/8bitdo-gc-bluetooth-gamepad . Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is the official product photo (HTTP 200). Wake-up support is explicitly unclear in the NL report and is not stated as fact.
items.imageAlt: 8BitDo GC Bluetooth Gamepad official product photo

items.title: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight adds GameShare on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo Life 引述官方更新說明，指《Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight》Switch 2 版已加入 GameShare，可經 GameChat 進行線上多人，同時有穩定度同效能修復。其他平台嘅更新加入選單旁白無障礙選項，但報導指 Switch 2 版目前未有呢項功能。
items.note: uncertain=true because publishedAt is approximate: NL listed the story as “8 hours ago” when fetched around 07:45 HKT on Nov 19, with no stamped clock time. Patch version number was not stated. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Valve says Steam app reviews are taking up to 12 business days as 2026 monthly releases peak at 3,738
items.summary: GamingOnLinux 引述 Valve 向開發者表示，雖然目標仍係 3 至 5 個工作日完成遊戲版本測試，但而家「有少少落後」，最長需要 12 個工作日，部分原因係要重新審查遊戲。GOL 引用 SteamDB 數字指，2026 年單月上架峰值已達 3,738 款（2025 年峰值為 2,415），年至今為 27,286 款，對比 2025 年全年 21,185 款。
items.note: GOL timestamp 18 Nov 2026 at 9:57 am UTC (updated 10:01 am UTC) = Nov 18, 17:57 HKT. All figures are as reported by GOL citing Valve and SteamDB; they were not independently re-counted.
items.imageAlt: GamingOnLinux article image for its Steam releases volume report

items.title: Nobunaga’s Ambition: Hishou’s Switch version is canceled; PS5, Switch 2 and PC remain slated for this winter
items.summary: Koei Tecmo 同開發組 Kou Shibusawa 已取消《信長の野望・飛翔》原先公布嘅 Switch 版。遊戲而家只會喺今冬於日本同亞洲登陸 PS5、Switch 2 同 Steam（PC），具體日期未定。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 18, 2026, 4:30 AM EST = Nov 18, 17:30 HKT. The canceled SKU is original Switch, not Switch 2. Winter 2026–27 Japan/Asia window is not a calendar day, so releaseDate is TBA. Gematsu hero 403’d, so imageUrl is null. Switch is listed because the canceled SKU is relevant.

items.title: Pillars of Eternity and Deadfire add full PC controller support, and the first game is now Steam Deck Verified
items.summary: GamingOnLinux 報道，《Pillars of Eternity》Patch 3.10.0 同《Deadfire》Patch 5.1.0.0 已為 PC 加入完整手把支援，涵蓋角色創建、探索、戰鬥同物品欄，並支援 Xbox、PlayStation 手把、Steam Deck 同 Big Picture。報導指第一作而家已獲 Steam Deck 同 Steam Machine Verified。
items.note: GOL timestamp 18 Nov 2026 at 9:07 am UTC = Nov 18, 17:07 HKT. “Verified on both” refers to Steam Deck and Steam Machine for Pillars of Eternity (the first game), per GOL.
items.imageAlt: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire screenshot used by GamingOnLinux

items.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game Patch 4.5 improves Switch 2 performance and docking
items.summary: Paramount Games 已推出《Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game》Patch 4.5。全平台改動包括 Ranked Rematch 15 秒計時、互相同意嘅平局選項，以及 Aang、Ozai 等角色試煉更新。Switch 2 專屬說明指整體效能有改善，並修復插拔底座時出現嘅問題。
items.note: NL timestamp “3:55am” under “Today Wed, 18th Nov 2026”, treated as UK GMT = Nov 18, 11:55 HKT. Platforms follow what the article names; Switch 2 notes are explicitly exclusive. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Splatoon 3 version 12.0.0 is out now, with Switch 2 GameChat invites and a trial two-player X Battle option
items.summary: Nintendo Life 喺 11 月 18 日更新指，《Splatoon 3》12.0.0 更新已可供下載，適用於 Switch 同 Switch 2。更新包括武器同特殊武器平衡、Anarchy Battle（Series）配對調整，以及 Chill Season 2026 起試行兩人組隊傳統 X Battle。Switch 2 限定可喺 Ready 狀態之前用十字鍵右開啟 GameChat 並邀請朋友。
items.note: NL “Update [Wed 18th Nov 2026, 12:05am]” treated as UK GMT = Nov 18, 08:05 HKT, just after yesterday’s 08:01 generatedAt; the “out now” confirmation was not in yesterday’s batch. Official patch notes are dated 17 November 2026. Nintendo Life og:image 403’d to automated checks, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Rockstar says PS5 Pro is not powerful enough to run GTA 6 at 60fps
items.summary: GamesRadar 引述 Rockstar 技術製作總監 Marc Chambers 向 Kotaku 嘅回應，指包括 PS5 Pro 喺內嘅現有硬件都無法提供更高幀率模式。Chambers 指 PS5 Pro 會用光追陰影同 PSSR 提升畫面，但 Pro 嘅中央處理器「不夠強，無法以更高幀率運行遊戲複雜模擬」。
items.note: publishedAt converted from GamesRadar article:published_time 2026-11-18T21:27:03Z. The Chambers quote originated in Kotaku (https://kotaku.com/gta-6-wont-get-a-60-fps-mode-even-on-ps5-pro-because-its-not-powerful-enough-2000755979, dated November 18, 2026). Digital Foundry analysis summarised by GamesRadar is not restated as independently verified frame-time data.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI screenshot used to illustrate the frame-rate story

items.title: PlayStation Network hit a confirmed mid-afternoon outage on November 18, hours before GTA 6
items.summary: The Guardian 報道，PlayStation Network 喺 11 月 18 日下午（《GTA VI》上市前數小時）出現大範圍故障，官方狀態頁承認可能無法啟動遊戲、應用或網絡功能。報道引述 Downdetector 當時有 1,228 宗用戶報告；Sony 未公布原因。
items.note: publishedAt converted from Guardian article:published_time 2026-11-18T20:28:42.000Z. PS4 is listed because coverage described PlayStation online services generally. Later follow-ups said service had largely recovered as the game unlocked in some regions; a precise official restoration time was not independently confirmed here, so it is not stated as fact. imageUrl is the article og:image.
items.imageAlt: A PlayStation 5 console, used with The Guardian’s GTA VI outage report

items.title: GTA 6 sits at 99 on Metacritic, ranked the highest-rated game of all time in a pre-launch snapshot
items.summary: Polygon 報道，評測解禁後《GTA 6》喺 Metacritic 嘅 PS5 同 Xbox Series X 版一度同列 99 分，並被列為當時史上評分最高遊戲（以超過 150 篇評論計算）。呢啲係 11 月 18 日當時嘅即時快照，分數同排名會隨更多評論而變動。
items.note: uncertain=true because aggregator scores and all-time rankings are a moving snapshot (Polygon “currently” / “as of Nov. 18”). publishedAt converted from Polygon’s byline Nov 18, 2026, 10:00 AM EST = Nov 19, 04:00 HKT.
items.imageAlt: Lucia Caminos in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: PlayStation Blog 宣布，《Grand Theft Auto VI》於 11 月 19 日登陸 PS5，並可喺 PlayStation Store 購買。故事發生喺 Leonida，主角係 Jason Duval 同 Lucia Caminos。Xbox Wire 另證實現身登陸 Xbox Series，並由 11 月 19 日美東時間凌晨 1 時起經 Xbox Cloud Gaming 喺 Xbox One 同 Series 遊玩；Xbox 版建議預留約 212 GB 空間。官方未提及 PC 版。
items.note: publishedAt converted from PlayStation Blog article:published_time 2026-11-18T08:00:23-08:00. Xbox One is cloud-only per Xbox Wire (https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/10/grand-theft-auto-6-comes-to-xbox-cloud-gaming-november-19/), not a native version. The 212GB figure is from Xbox Wire Nov 17 (https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/11/17/how-to-get-ready-for-november-19/) and is stated for Xbox Series X|S.
items.imageAlt: Official Grand Theft Auto VI key art of Jason and Lucia

items.title: PS5 system software 26.07-14.23.00 is required to play GTA 6, Sony says
items.summary: VGC 報道，Sony 推出約 1.2 GB 嘅 PS5 系統軟件 26.07-14.23.00，並指必須更新先可以玩《GTA 6》。官方說明只寫對系統軟件做咗一啲安全性修復。The Verge 將下載體積寫作 1.267 GB，並同樣指呢次更新係必須。
items.note: publishedAt converted from VGC dateline 18th Nov 2026 / 10:06 am, treated as UK GMT. The Verge corroboration for 1.267GB: https://www.theverge.com/games/1036395/if-you-want-to-play-gta-vi-on-ps5-tonight-download-yesterdays-firmware-update-first (article:published_time 2026-11-18T09:36:18+00:00). VGC og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Build A Rocket Boy, in administration, says it has started litigation it hopes can help repay about £62 million in debts
items.summary: VGC 引述 Build A Rocket Boy 管理層呈報，公司認為《MindsEye》銷情可能受到有組織嘅負評活動影響，並已對部分第三方展開訴訟，希望有助償還約 6,200 萬英鎊債務。呈報同時強調追討金額同結果仍不確定。呢啲係公司喺文件中嘅說法，並非法庭已裁定存在破壞行為。
items.note: publishedAt converted from VGC dateline 18th Nov 2026 / 10:09 pm, treated as UK GMT. The £62 million figure is as reported by VGC from the administration context. Platforms are MindsEye’s known release platforms and were not restated in this VGC article. VGC og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: The Rockstar union-busting employment tribunal has ended, with a verdict still pending
items.summary: VGC 報道，針對 Rockstar 嘅格拉斯哥僱傭審裁已經結束聆訊，最終裁決仍未公布。案件涉及 2025 年被解僱嘅 34 名員工，工會 IWGB 指解僱屬非法打擊工會，Rockstar 否認並指員工洩露機密資料。旁聽嘅 People Make Games 記者指判決可能要數星期至數個月。
items.note: publishedAt converted from VGC dateline 18th Nov 2026 / 6:04 pm, treated as UK GMT. Platforms refer to GTA 6, the game VGC says the dismissed staff had been working on; the case itself is a UK labour dispute. VGC og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: GTA 6 peaks at about 7.89 million concurrent livestream viewers, per preliminary Streams Charts data
items.summary: Polygon 引述 Streams Charts 初步數據，指《GTA 6》喺 Twitch、YouTube、Kick 等平台合計同時觀眾峰值為 7,886,402，其中 Twitch 約 329 萬、YouTube 約 319 萬、Kick 約 148 萬。報道指數字仍可能隨更多地區解鎖而上升，因此只係當時嘅初步統計。
items.note: uncertain=true because Polygon explicitly calls the data preliminary and says the peak could still rise. publishedAt converted from article:published_time 2026-11-18T17:52:28Z.
items.imageAlt: Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto VI

items.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 lead narrative designer Jennifer Svedberg-Yen has parted ways with Sandfall
items.summary: VGC 引述 GamesBeat 訪問報道，《Clair Obscur: Expedition 33》首席敘事設計師 Jennifer Svedberg-Yen 已離開 Sandfall Interactive。她表示自己喺 7 月完成最後工作後分開，之後想做自己嘅項目同指導新晉編劇。Sandfall 尚未公開說明呢次離職，亦未公布下一個項目。
items.note: publishedAt converted from VGC dateline 18th Nov 2026 / 4:54 pm, treated as UK GMT. The departure itself was in July 2026; the news is the November 18 confirmation/interview. Platforms are the widely reported release platforms for Expedition 33 and were not restated in the VGC article. VGC og:image 403’d, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Sensor Tower raises its GTA 6 pre-order estimate to 17.07 million units and about $1.65 billion
items.summary: GameSpot 引述 Sensor Tower 更新嘅非官方預購追蹤，估計《GTA 6》預購已達 1,707 萬套、總收入約 16.5 億美元，其中 PS5 約 1,273 萬套／12.3 億美元，Xbox Series 約 435 萬套／4.19 億美元。呢啲仍係第三方估計，並非 Rockstar 或 Take-Two 官方銷量。
items.note: REAL UPDATE versus yesterday’s GamesIndustry.biz Sensor Tower story ($1.4bn pre-orders). publishedAt converted from GameSpot byline November 18, 2026 at 4:37AM PST = Nov 18, 20:37 HKT. Figures are third-party estimates, not official sales.

items.title: ARIKA director and software-development head Akira Kurabayashi has died
items.summary: Gematsu 引述 ARIKA 社長 Akira Nishitani 宣布，董事兼軟件開發部門負責人 Akira Kurabayashi 於 2026 年 11 月 14 日因心臟衰竭突然去世。佢早年喺 Taito 擔任程式（包括《Darius Gaiden》），後喺 ARIKA 參與 Street Fighter EX 系列、《Tetris the Grandmaster》、Tetris 99 同 PAC-MAN 99 等作品。
items.note: In the 48-hour window but outside the preferred last 24 hours (Gematsu 1:58 AM EST Nov 17 / 14:58 HKT Nov 17). Not in yesterday’s batch or skip list, so included as a missed item. Official studio notice: https://www.arika.co.jp/info_jp/news-detail.php?id=115 .
